user.title: Add Nanoleaf Light
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Nanoleaf device.

data_description.ip_address: IPv6 address of the device (ULA preferred, e.g. fd00::...). Found via mDNS or your router.
data_description.port: Use the discovered device port: 12566 for newer firmware, or 5653/5683 for legacy firmware.
data_description.model: Device model from the label or mDNS. Required for NL45/NL55/NL58/NL62.
data_description.name: Device name shown by discovery or Nanoleaf Desktop (e.g. Essentials-E20). Required for pairing with newer firmware.

pair.title: Pair Device

data_description.pairing_code: Code from the device label. NL67 and newer: 11-digit (e.g. 3394-532-2503). NL45 and older: 8-digit (e.g. 1234-5678). Dashes are optional.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The access token for **{name}** was rejected. Enter the pairing code again to re-pair.

data_description.pairing_code: Code from the device label. NL67 and newer: 11-digit (e.g. 3394-532-2503). NL45 and older: 8-digit (e.g. 1234-5678). Dashes are optional.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Reconfigure {name}
reconfigure_confirm.description: Update the connection settings for **{name}**. Leave the pairing code blank to keep the existing token (useful when only the IP address changed).

data_description.ip_address: New IPv6 address of the device.
data_description.port: Use the discovered device port: 12566 for newer firmware, or 5653/5683 for legacy firmware.
data_description.pairing_code: Leave blank to keep the current token. Enter the code from the device label to re-pair.
data_description.name: Device name shown by discovery or Nanoleaf Desktop (e.g. Essentials-E20). Required for pairing with newer firmware.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to device. Check the address and that the device is reachable.
error.invalid_pin: Pairing failed. Check the pairing code and that the device is not already paired to another controller.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

set_circadian_config.name: Configure circadian lighting
set_circadian_config.description: Store a complete white-point schedule on the bulb. Sunrise/sunset mode also copies Home Assistant's clock, timezone and location to the bulb.

rise_time_minutes.name: Daytime start
rise_time_minutes.description: Required for explicit mode; minutes after midnight, from 0 to 1439.

fall_time_minutes.name: Evening start
fall_time_minutes.description: Required for explicit mode; minutes after midnight, from 0 to 1439.

sunrise_offset_minutes.name: Sunrise offset
sunrise_offset_minutes.description: Required for sunrise/sunset mode. Positive values start later; negative values start earlier.

sunset_offset_minutes.name: Sunset offset
sunset_offset_minutes.description: Required for sunrise/sunset mode. Positive values start later; negative values start earlier.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Select the integration entry directly when calling from a script.

set_device_time.name: Set device time
set_device_time.description: Set the bulb's clock and timezone. Omitted values use the current time and Home Assistant's configured timezone.

epoch_seconds.name: UTC time
epoch_seconds.description: Unix epoch seconds. Leave empty to use the current time.

timezone_offset_seconds.name: Timezone offset
timezone_offset_seconds.description: Offset from UTC in seconds. Leave empty to use Home Assistant's configured timezone.

set_device_location.name: Set device location
set_device_location.description: Store the location used by the bulb's sunrise/sunset schedule.

get_motion_capabilities.name: Get motion capabilities
get_motion_capabilities.description: Read supported scene motions, their options, and palette/storage limits. Returns devices keyed by integration entry ID.
